title: Viewport Superpowers 🦸
description: Advanced viewport controls, view modes, and visualisation helpers.

slides.title: Beyond WASD 🎮
slides.content:
# Flight Controls Refresher

You already know the basics. Let’s level up.

| Control | Action |
|---------|--------|
| Right Mouse (hold) | Look / turn |
| WASD (with right mouse) | Fly forward / backward / left / right |
| Q / E | Fly down / up |
| Scroll wheel | Zoom in / out |
| Middle Mouse (hold + drag) | Pan |
| F | Focus on selected object |

**New:** Hold **Shift** while flying to move faster. Hold **Ctrl** to slow down for precision.

quizData.question: Hold the _____ key while flying to move faster through the viewport.
quizData.explanation: Holding Shift increases camera speed; Ctrl reduces it for fine adjustments.

slides.title: View Modes 🎨
slides.content:
## Change How You See the World

Click the **View Mode** button (top‑left corner of viewport). Options include:

* **Lit** – default, full lighting and materials.
* **Unlit** – ignore lights; all surfaces show base color. Great for finding texture errors.
* **Wireframe** – see polygon edges. Essential for optimisation.
* **Detail Lighting** – shows only direct light contribution.
* **Lighting Only** – just the lightmap.
* **Shader Complexity** – visualise how expensive materials are.

Toggle between them with hotkeys: **Alt+2** (Unlit), **Alt+3** (Wireframe), **Alt+4** (Lit).

quizData.question: Which view mode shows polygon edges, making it useful for optimisation checks?
quizData.explanation: Wireframe renders only geometry edges, helping you see the polygon density of meshes.

slides.title: Show Flags & Visualisation 🕶️
slides.content:
## Extra Viewport Helpers

Click the **Show** dropdown (top‑left) to toggle visibility of:

* **Grid** – reference grid in perspective view.
* **Collision** – see collision shapes (great for debugging physics).
* **Bounds** – selection boxes of actors.
* **Fog, Post Processing, Particles** – turn off for clean preview.

Also under **Viewport Options** (three‑line menu):
* **Game View (G)** – hide editor icons; simulate how players see it.
* **Immersive Mode (F11)** – full‑screen viewport only.
* **High Resolution Screenshot** – capture beauty shots.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Bookmark Camera Positions

Press **Ctrl + 1…9** to save a camera position. Press **1…9** alone to jump back to that bookmarked view. Super useful when navigating large levels!
